plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-12 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Engineering Technology - Electromechanical Emphasis program page and its linked official degree map workbook, 'Engineering Technology Degree Maps (2026-2027)', 'Electromechanical (Campus)' tab, last updated/reviewed August 3, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. BS-only program: the catalog prints a single line, Total Credits, BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; no BA option is printed and the map carries no foreign-language note. The catalog's General Education block prints only Core Course Requirements (12+ credits) and Breadth Area Requirements (16+ credits) with 'See General Education for course options'; the map's GE rows are recorded as printed. The catalog's Free Electives section prints no fixed figure (the total is determined by the General Education courses taken, degree type, additional credits earned and prerequisite courses needed). Every term's courses sum to the map's printed term total (16/15/15/15/15/15/14/15) and the plan to the catalog's printed BS degree total of 120. Cross-check: every catalog curriculum block reconciles exactly -- Engineering Technology Core Requirements 31-32, Mechanical Engineering Requirements 16, Electrical Engineering Technology Requirements 21, Curriculum 68-69 -- and every named catalog course appears on the map. The map exercises the Core's mathematics choice at MATH 1210 - Calculus I (4 credits), the top of the Complete One of the Following range (MATH 1100 - Applied Calculus, 3 credits, or MATH 1210, 4 credits), so the Core is exercised at 32 of its printed 31-32; the slot is recorded as a choice slot with both catalog options. The catalog states this major does not include the requisite number of upper-division hours and that students fill the upper-division requirement with elective credit; the map's free rows total 35 credits (7 Free Electives + 28 Free Upper-division Electives), recorded as printed. Catalog-versus-map differences, transcribed as printed in the map and disclosed, not reconciled: the map prints Digital Circuits I under the code EET 2780 where the catalog lists EE 2780 - Digital Circuits I (the catalog code is recorded); the catalog tags PHYS 2010 as [GE Quantitative Literacy] on this program page where the map labels it (GE Physical Sciences); the map shortens ENGR 1030 to 'Computer-Aided Modeling & Analysis (GE Arts)' where the catalog title is 'Computer-Aided Parametric Modeling and Analysis Using Solidworks' (the catalog title is recorded); and the map's generic 'COMM/ENGL Major Technical Communication Course*' row is recorded as a choice slot carrying the catalog's Complete One of the Following options, COMM 4240 - Technical Writing and ENGL 4360 - Grant and Technical Writing. Catalog titles are recorded where the map abbreviates or substitutes '&' for 'and'. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
